notes.text: M0: regime likely loose (spot 0.85x idx). launch prior 11-18 uniform. brokers unknown, testing A with 2k. growth unknown (prior 5%). Plan: buy H early (cheaper than reserving), power for ~45 kH H, spot to front-load window1.
M1: tight headline + rival buying

M2: index fell 7pct and price-cut news so likely loose (~75pct). Launch rumours 17 and 19 so likely 17-18. Broker A delivered (1 obs, lean reliable). Inference 6.6 (noisy, growth unknown). Window1 on track. Plan: buy more H around months 4-10 for window3 and add power for after month 19.

M3: loose likely (7.66k shipped, spot 0.72x idx). Launch rumours 17/19/16 so launch 17 or 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 7.7 - leaning 7pct growth. Bought 12k H for windows 2-3 and 18 MW. Window3 extra via post-launch cheap reservations and spot.
M4: tight headline and spot 1.12x idx but index flat - regime ~55pct loose. Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 6.9 - growth uncertain ~50/50. Window1 done next month. No actions, conserving cash.

M5: loose likely (index -13pct, CoWoS news). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1 untested further. Inference 7.2 - leaning 3-5pct. Window1 complete. 44k H owned+queued covers window2 easily. Plan: power top-up ~month 12 for post-19, post-launch reservations for window3 gap.
M6: loose likely (price cut news, index falling). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 8.64 - now leaning 7pct growth (implies ~29 kH by m23). Window3 gap may be ~20 kH beyond 44k H. No action.
M7: regime probably loose (index roughly flat, no headline). Launch 17-18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 9.1 - 7pct likely. Window2 covered by 44k H (power 64 MW from m8). No action.

M8: loose likely (inventory building news). Launch rumours 17/19/16/17/20 so most likely month 18. Broker A 1/1 (may decay 8-15). Inference 10.7 - 7pct growth likely, could switch. Window1 met. Window2 has big surplus with 44k H. Window3 gap ~20-25 kH: plan 6m reservation at m15 (16-21) plus 6m at m17/18 and spot, decide power vs resale of unpowered H after m19 around m12.
M9: loose likely (spot 0.85x idx, index -4pct). Launch most likely 18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 10.4 - 7pct still likely. Window2 will be met by ~m12. No action.
M10: tight headline but index -8pct so still likely loose (~70pct). Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 11.2 - 7pct likely. Window2 on pace. No action.

M11: loose likely (spot 0.97x idx, index flat-down). Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 12.0 - 7pct. Window2 met by m12. Window3 need ~490 kH-mo, owned H gives ~350 with extra 14 MW (signed now, total 24mo cost fixed). Gap ~140-180: reserve 6m in m14/15/17 at caps plus spot.

M12: loose (index -8pct). Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 12.3 - 7pct but could switch. Window2 meets this month. New 14 MW energises m19 so all 44k H powered through m23. Window3 gap ~17 kH/mo: reserve at m15 and m17, spot to fill.

M13: loose (inventory news, though spot 1.6x idx is noisy). Launch ~18 (rumours 16-20). Broker A 1/1. Inference 14.4 - 7pct, projecting ~30 kH by m23. Window2 met. Window3 gap ~20 kH/mo. Plan reserve 10kH 6m at m14 and m15, more at m17, spot fill.

M14: regime mixed - spot ~1.6x idx two months (tight sign) but index -4pct (loose sign), ~55pct loose. Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 14.0 - 7pct. Reserved 10 kH 6m (m15-20) as hedge against tight caps. More at m15 and m17.

M15: loose (index -7pct, price-cut news). Launch most likely 18 (all rumours consistent only with 18). Broker A 1/1. Inference 17.0 - 7pct, ~31 by m23. Window3 need ~520 kH-mo. Reserved another 10 kH 6m (m16-21). Next: post-launch reservations for m19-23 and spot.

M16: loose (inventory news, index -5pct). Export-control rumour (spot could drop to 60pct). Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Inference ~18.5 - 7pct. Window3 projection with current capacity ~272 of 320. Reserved 6 kH 6m (m17-22). Plan another ~8 kH at m18 post-launch discount plus spot top-up to reach ~340.

M17: loose (HBM news, spot 0.78 = 0.78x idx). Launch confirmed m18. Broker A 1/1, unused. Inference 18.9 - 7pct. Window3 projection ~305 without more. Spot 10 kH at 0.78 now, then post-launch reservation m18 for m19-23.

M18: loose (CoWoS news). Gen N launched m18 - not buying (only 3 usable months). Broker A 1/1, unused. Inference 19.2 - growth maybe slowing toward 3-5pct. Window3 at 106, projection ~333 with spot 10 this month. Reserved 4 kH 6m (m19-24) post-launch for margin. Keep spot 10 this month then reassess.

M19: regime uncertain (tight headline, spot 1.03x idx, index flat) ~55pct loose. Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference 20.2 - growth ~5pct recently. Window3 projected ~355 without spot so spot off, re-add if inference spikes.
M20: loose-ish (spot 0.84x idx). Launched m18. Broker A 1/1. Inference jumped to 24.8 - 7pct (or switched up). Window3 projected ~337, margin thin, adding 8 kH spot at 0.67 this month.
M21: loose (price-cut news, spot 0.81x idx). Broker A 1/1. Inference 24.9 - flat month, growth 3-7pct. Window3 at 272, projected ~353 without spot, so spot off.
M22: loose-ish. Broker A 1/1. Inference 27.7 - 7pct. Window3 needs 11.7 more, this month gives ~22 even after reselling 3k H (resale 7.2/k beats end mark ~6.9/k).
M23: all three runs met. Inference ~29-30 vs 42 kH capacity after resale. Resold 3k more H (slightly above end mark).
